hook.title: Airport security
hook.text: A scanner flags bags. **Precision**: of the bags it flagged, how many truly held something. **Recall**: of all the bags that truly held something, how many did it catch. If only 1% of bags are dangerous, a scanner that flags *nothing* is 99% accurate and completely useless. **F1** combines precision and recall into one number that punishes lopsided performance.
hook.recall: Remember airport security: precision = trustworthiness of the alarms, recall = coverage of the real threats, accuracy can flatter a lazy model when positives are rare.

tasks: Start with TP=40, FP=10, FN=20, TN=130. Then raise TN to 400. What moves?
Make FP and FN both large. What does F1 do?

build.reveal: Recall $=30/(30+30)=0.5$: the scanner caught half of the real threats. (Precision would be $30/40=0.75$.)
